entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
I need to return my VeloBand Pulse. It's not working.
I can certainly look into that for you. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's defective. The thing won't sync with my phone, which makes it pretty useless. I think it's broken.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with it. I'll just need to pull up your order details. Can I get your name and the order number, please?
Sarah Jenkins. The order number is... V F 8 8 1 2 9.
Thank you, Sarah. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. It looks like it was delivered 35 days ago, on December 15th.
Alright, I'm just checking our return eligibility for you... Yes, it looks like you're unfortunately outside our 10-day return period.
Great. So you'll take it back?

Absolutely. Since you're reporting the item is defective, I've gone ahead and approved the return. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file for you now. Just pack it up in the original box and drop it off.
Whatever. As long as it's handled. How long until I get my money back?
Once our warehouse receives the item, a full refund will be processed to your original form of payment within 3 to 5 business days. You should see that email with the label in the next few minutes.
Perfect. Was there anything else I could assist you with today, Sarah?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
